'''2009 Yavin 4 Regionals Brian Brodsky DS Combat Readiness''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brian Brodsky]] at [[2009 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Combat Readiness|Endor-D-combatreadiness.gif}}
* '''Username:''' bbrodsky50
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
